Loading

Loading states communicate that content is being fetched. ZAKUIKit provides inline indicators, bars, dots, overlays, and skeleton patterns.

Loading Button

Attach data-zak-loading-btn to any button; clicking swaps its content for a spinner (via zak.loadingButton).

Loading Overlay

Cover a container with a translucent overlay and a centered spinner.

HTML
<div style="position:relative;min-height:14rem;">
    <!-- blurred content -->
    <div class="zak-stack">...</div>

    <!-- overlay -->
    <div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
         background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--zak-surface) 70%, transparent);z-index:2;">
        <span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-lg" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></span>
    </div>
</div>

Loading Page

A full-viewport loading screen for boot-time or route transitions.

Loading your workspace...
HTML
<div style="position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
     background:var(--zak-surface);z-index:var(--zak-z-modal);">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1rem;">
        <span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-xl" role="status" aria-label="Loading page"></span>
        <span style="color:var(--zak-text-muted);">Loading your workspace...</span>
    </div>
</div>

Loading with Text

Use .zak-loading for a compact inline indicator with a label.

Fetching data...
HTML
<div class="zak-loading">
    <span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-sm" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></span>
    Fetching data...
</div>

Loading with Spinner

Standalone spinners at different sizes, paired with the loading wrapper.

HTML
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-sm"></span>  <!-- small -->
<span class="zak-spinner"></span>              <!-- default -->
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-lg"></span>  <!-- large -->

Loading with Progress

Show determinate progress during long-running operations.

Uploading62%
HTML
<div>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;">
        <span>Uploading</span><span>62%</span>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-progress">
        <div class="zak-progress-bar" style="width:62%;"></div>
    </div>
</div>

Loading with Skeleton

Skeletons preview content structure while it loads.

HTML
<div class="zak-stack">
    <span class="zak-skeleton zak-skeleton-lg"></span>
    <span class="zak-skeleton"></span>
    <span class="zak-skeleton" style="width:70%;"></span>
</div>

Loading Bars and Dots

Alternative pulse indicators: bouncing bars and pulsing dots.

HTML
<div class="zak-loading-bars" role="status" aria-label="Loading">
    <span class="zak-bar"></span><span class="zak-bar"></span><span class="zak-bar"></span>
</div>

<div class="zak-loading-dots" role="status" aria-label="Loading">
    <span class="zak-dot"></span><span class="zak-dot"></span><span class="zak-dot"></span>
</div>

Centered Loading

Center the indicator inside any container using flex utilities.

Please wait
HTML
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:10rem;">
    <div class="zak-stack" style="align-items:center;">
        <span class="zak-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></span>
        <span>Please wait</span>
    </div>
</div>

Loading in Specific Container

Restrict the loading state to a card or panel rather than the whole page.

Loading analytics...
HTML
<div class="zak-card" style="max-width:22rem;min-height:12rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">
    <div class="zak-stack" style="align-items:center;padding:2rem;">
        <span class="zak-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading analytics"></span>
        <span>Loading analytics...</span>
    </div>
</div>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-loading         /* Inline-flex label + indicator */
.zak-spinner         /* Rotating ring */
.zak-loading-bars    /* Bouncing bar trio */
.zak-bar             /* Bar element */
.zak-loading-dots    /* Pulsing dot trio */
.zak-dot             /* Dot element */
.zak-progress        /* Progress track */
.zak-skeleton        /* Shimmer placeholder */

Accessibility

  • Add role="status" and an aria-label to each loading indicator.
  • Set aria-busy="true" on the content region while it loads.
  • When loading finishes, update the region and set aria-busy="false".
  • Provide a static equivalent (text) alongside any animated indicator.
  • Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
HTML
<div id="feed" aria-busy="true">
    <div class="zak-loading">
        <span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-sm" role="status" aria-label="Loading feed"></span>
        Loading feed...
    </div>
</div>
